Atlanta Hawks.name: Keshon Gilbert
Atlanta Hawks.note: Gilbert (knee) is out for Saturday's game against Brooklyn.

Atlanta Hawks.name: Asa Newell
Atlanta Hawks.note: Newell (toe)  is out for Saturday's game against the Nets.

Atlanta Hawks.name: Jock Landale
Atlanta Hawks.note: Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Nets.

Atlanta Hawks.name: Mouhamed Gueye
Atlanta Hawks.note: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

Atlanta Hawks.name: Henri Veesaar
Atlanta Hawks.note: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

Brooklyn Nets.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
Brooklyn Nets.note: Brown, who finished with 18 points (5-13 FG, 3-8 3Pt, 5-7 FT), one rebound, three assists and one steal over 25 minutes in Saturday's 124-121 loss to Atlanta, won't play in Sunday's game against Dallas, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Brooklyn Nets.name: Egor Demin
Brooklyn Nets.note: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

Charlotte Hornets.name: Moussa Diabate
Charlotte Hornets.note: Diabate (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Boston, according to the Hornets' official injury report.

Charlotte Hornets.name: Brandon Miller
Charlotte Hornets.note: Head coach Charles Lee said Miller (groin) will be re-evaluated over the weekend, and they expect to have more information by Monday, Steve Reed of The Associated Press reports.

Charlotte Hornets.name: Dennis Schroder
Charlotte Hornets.note: Schroder (thigh) is out for Friday's game versus Boston.

Charlotte Hornets.name: Kon Knueppel
Charlotte Hornets.note: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.

Charlotte Hornets.name: Grant Williams
Charlotte Hornets.note: The Hornets recalled Williams (hamstring) from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Wednesday.

Chicago Bulls.name: Tobe Awaka
Chicago Bulls.note: Awaka (knee) is questionable for Sundays' game against the 76ers.

Chicago Bulls.name: Jalen Smith
Chicago Bulls.note: Smith (finger) is probable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

Chicago Bulls.name: Nic Claxton
Chicago Bulls.note: Claxton (hamstring) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against the 76ers.

Chicago Bulls.name: Zach Collins
Chicago Bulls.note: Collins (illness) is out for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

Cleveland Cavaliers.name: Jaylon Tyson
Cleveland Cavaliers.note: Tyson (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

Cleveland Cavaliers.name: Sam Merrill
Cleveland Cavaliers.note: Merrill (elbow) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

Cleveland Cavaliers.name: Jarrett Allen
Cleveland Cavaliers.note: Allen (knee) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks

Dallas Mavericks.name: Sergio de Larrea
Dallas Mavericks.note: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.

Dallas Mavericks.name: Tarik Biberovic
Dallas Mavericks.note: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.

Dallas Mavericks.name: Dereck Lively II
Dallas Mavericks.note: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.

Denver Nuggets.name: Julian Strawther
Denver Nuggets.note: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

Detroit Pistons.name: Isaiah Joe
Detroit Pistons.note: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lakers.

Detroit Pistons.name: Isaac Jones
Detroit Pistons.note: Jones posted 18 points (6-14 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 3-3 FT), 10 rebounds, an assist, two steals and two blocks in Wednesday's 100-88 Summer League loss to the Suns.

Detroit Pistons.name: Elijah Harkless
Detroit Pistons.note: Harkless signed a two-way contract with the Pistons, Keith Smith of Spotrac.com reports.

Detroit Pistons.name: Jalen Duren
Detroit Pistons.note: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Golden State Warriors.name: Kristaps Porzingis
Golden State Warriors.note: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

Golden State Warriors.name: Moses Moody
Golden State Warriors.note: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

Golden State Warriors.name: Jimmy Butler III
Golden State Warriors.note: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

Houston Rockets.name: Clint Capela
Houston Rockets.note: Capela (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Suns.

Houston Rockets.name: Steven Adams
Houston Rockets.note: Head coach Ime Udoka said Wednesday that Adams (calf) is still without a timetable to return and will be evaluated on a "weekly basis," Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.

Indiana Pacers.name: Tyrese Haliburton
Indiana Pacers.note: Haliburton (hamstring) is progressing well but does not have a timetable to return, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

Indiana Pacers.name: Johnny Furphy
Indiana Pacers.note: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

Indiana Pacers.name: Ben Sheppard
Indiana Pacers.note: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

Los Angeles Clippers.name: Brandon Ingram
Los Angeles Clippers.note: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Sunday's game against New Orleans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
